schema.text: What would make you cycle more often or further?

options.text: More cycle lanes separated from traffic
Better road surfaces on bike routes
More safe bike parking where I go
Safer junctions and crossings for bikes
Money help (e.g. bonus to buy a bike, employer allowance)
Being able to take a bicycle or e-scooter on buses, trams, the metro or trains
Nothing: I'm happy as things are

en.#What would make you cycle more often or: What would make you cycle more often or further?

it.#What would make you cycle more often or: Cosa ti farebbe andare in bici più spesso o più lontano?
it.#More cycle lanes separated from traffic: Più piste ciclabili separate dal traffico
it.#Better road surfaces on bike routes: Fondo stradale migliore sui percorsi ciclabili
it.#More safe bike parking where I go: Più parcheggi sicuri per le bici dove vado
it.#Safe bike storage near home: Un posto sicuro per tenere la bici vicino a casa
it.#Slower traffic in residential streets: Traffico più lento nelle strade residenziali
it.#Safer junctions and crossings for bikes: Incroci e attraversamenti più sicuri per le bici
it.#Money help (e.g. bonus to buy a bike, e: Un aiuto economico (ad es. bonus per comprare una bici, contributo del datore di lavoro)
it.#Continuous cycle routes connecting neig: Percorsi ciclabili continui che collegano i quartieri
it.#Being able to take a bicycle or e-scoot: Poter portare la bicicletta o il monopattino su autobus, tram, metro o treni

fr.#What would make you cycle more often or: Qu'est-ce qui vous ferait faire du vélo plus souvent ou plus loin ?
fr.#More cycle lanes separated from traffic: Plus de pistes cyclables séparées de la circulation
fr.#Better road surfaces on bike routes: De meilleurs revêtements sur les itinéraires cyclables
fr.#More safe bike parking where I go: Plus de stationnement sûr pour les vélos là où je vais
fr.#Safe bike storage near home: Un endroit sûr pour garder mon vélo près de chez moi
fr.#Slower traffic in residential streets: Une circulation plus lente dans les rues résidentielles
fr.#Safer junctions and crossings for bikes: Des carrefours et des passages plus sûrs pour les vélos
fr.#Cycling lessons or courses: Des cours ou des formations de vélo
fr.#Money help (e.g. bonus to buy a bike, e: Une aide financière (par ex. prime pour acheter un vélo, aide de l'employeur)
fr.#Continuous cycle routes connecting neig: Des itinéraires cyclables continus reliant les quartiers
fr.#Being able to take a bicycle or e-scoot: Pouvoir emporter son vélo ou sa trottinette dans les bus, tramways, métros ou trains

de.#What would make you cycle more often or: Was würde Sie dazu bringen, öfter oder weiter Rad zu fahren?
de.#More safe bike parking where I go: Mehr sichere Fahrradabstellplätze dort, wo ich hinfahre
de.#Safe bike storage near home: Sichere Fahrradaufbewahrung in der Nähe meiner Wohnung
de.#Safer junctions and crossings for bikes: Sicherere Kreuzungen und Übergänge für Fahrräder
de.#Money help (e.g. bonus to buy a bike, e: Finanzielle Hilfe (z. B. Zuschuss zum Fahrradkauf, Zuschuss vom Arbeitgeber)
de.#Being able to take a bicycle or e-scoot: Fahrrad oder E-Scooter in Bussen, Straßenbahnen, U-Bahnen oder Zügen mitnehmen können
de.#Nothing: I'm happy as things are: Nichts: Ich bin zufrieden, wie es ist

tr.#What would make you cycle more often or: Sizi daha sık veya daha uzağa bisiklet sürmeye ne teşvik ederdi?
tr.#More cycle lanes separated from traffic: Trafikten ayrılmış daha fazla bisiklet yolu
tr.#Better road surfaces on bike routes: Bisiklet güzergâhlarında daha iyi yol yüzeyleri
tr.#More safe bike parking where I go: Gittiğim yerlerde daha fazla güvenli bisiklet park yeri
tr.#Safe bike storage near home: Evimin yakınında güvenli bisiklet saklama yeri
tr.#Safer junctions and crossings for bikes: Bisikletler için daha güvenli kavşaklar ve geçitler
tr.#Money help (e.g. bonus to buy a bike, e: Maddi destek (örn. bisiklet almak için bonus, işveren desteği)
tr.#Continuous cycle routes connecting neig: Mahalleleri birbirine bağlayan kesintisiz bisiklet güzergâhları
tr.#Being able to take a bicycle or e-scoot: Bisikleti veya elektrikli scooterı otobüs, tramvay, metro veya trene alabilmek

fa.#What would make you cycle more often or: چه چیزی باعث می‌شود بیشتر یا دورتر دوچرخه‌سواری کنید؟
fa.#More cycle lanes separated from traffic: مسیرهای دوچرخه بیشتر، جدا از ترافیک
fa.#Better road surfaces on bike routes: سطح جاده بهتر در مسیرهای دوچرخه
fa.#More safe bike parking where I go: جای امن بیشتر برای دوچرخه در جاهایی که می‌روم
fa.#Safe bike storage near home: جای امن نگهداری دوچرخه نزدیک خانه
fa.#Safer junctions and crossings for bikes: چهارراه‌ها و گذرگاه‌های امن‌تر برای دوچرخه
fa.#Money help (e.g. bonus to buy a bike, e: کمک مالی (مثلاً بن خرید دوچرخه، کمک‌هزینه از کارفرما)
fa.#Continuous cycle routes connecting neig: مسیرهای پیوستهٔ دوچرخه که محله‌ها را به هم وصل کنند
fa.#Being able to take a bicycle or e-scoot: امکان بردن دوچرخه یا اسکوتر برقی در اتوبوس، تراموا، مترو یا قطار
fa.#Nothing: I'm happy as things are: هیچ چیز: وضعیت فعلی برایم خوب است

hu.#What would make you cycle more often or: Mi késztetné arra, hogy gyakrabban vagy messzebb biciklizzen?
hu.#More safe bike parking where I go: Több biztonságos kerékpártároló ott, ahová járok
hu.#Safer junctions and crossings for bikes: Biztonságosabb kereszteződések és átkelők a kerékpárosoknak
hu.#Money help (e.g. bonus to buy a bike, e: Anyagi támogatás (pl. kerékpárvásárlási támogatás, munkáltatói juttatás)
hu.#Continuous cycle routes connecting neig: A városrészeket összekötő, összefüggő kerékpáros útvonalak
hu.#Being able to take a bicycle or e-scoot: Lehetőség a kerékpár vagy az elektromos roller szállítására buszon, villamoson, metrón vagy vonaton

ar.#What would make you cycle more often or: ما الذي يجعلك تركب الدراجة أكثر أو لمسافات أبعد؟
ar.#More cycle lanes separated from traffic: مزيد من مسارات الدراجات المفصولة عن حركة المرور
ar.#Better road surfaces on bike routes: أسطح طرق أفضل على مسارات الدراجات
ar.#More safe bike parking where I go: مزيد من مواقف الدراجات الآمنة في الأماكن التي أذهب إليها
ar.#Safe bike storage near home: مكان آمن لحفظ الدراجة قرب المنزل
ar.#Slower traffic in residential streets: حركة مرور أبطأ في الشوارع السكنية
ar.#Cycling lessons or courses: دروس أو دورات في ركوب الدراجة
ar.#Money help (e.g. bonus to buy a bike, e: مساعدة مالية (مثل منحة لشراء دراجة أو بدل من صاحب العمل)
ar.#Continuous cycle routes connecting neig: مسارات دراجات متصلة تربط بين الأحياء
ar.#Being able to take a bicycle or e-scoot: إمكانية اصطحاب الدراجة أو السكوتر الكهربائي في الحافلات أو الترام أو المترو أو القطارات
ar.#Nothing: I'm happy as things are: لا شيء: الوضع الحالي مناسب لي
